- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next period.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model underestimates; adjust upward by 1–2% if recent price is trending up.  
- If model shows a sharp spike in forecast followed by a drop, it often overcorrects; cap forecast at 1–2% below true peak.  
- Model consistently underestimates true price in the 10–15 day horizon; apply +1.5% bias to forecast for 10–15 day ahead.  
- If sentiment shifts from negative to positive mid-period, model lags; add 0.5–1.0% to forecast at 10–12 day mark to catch momentum.  
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day horizon; if forecast is > 20% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 10–15% for next 10 days.
